title: Themes (record/views/index/themes.json)
description: Decision 0058 rule 4, built by themes.js once a run: groups of 3 stories or more connected by judged links (index/web.json `links`; shared-actor pairs never join a group; merged ids resolved to the surviving story, one link per story pair: the strongest, ties by the newest). Strong and medium links join first; then each weak link, most cited entries first, then newest cited date, then from, to, joins two groups only if the smaller has at most 2 stories (it can attach one story or one pair, never two groups of 3 or more). A weak link inside one theme is a link of it; a refused weak link is in no theme. A pair or a lone story has no theme (its stamp `themeId` is null). `themeId` = theme-<threadId of the anchor>, the story with the earliest `born` (ties: smaller threadId). `lead`: the story with the most judged links inside the theme, ties by highest tier, then newest lastFactAt, then smaller threadId. `countries`: the stamps' iso3 counted per story. `tier`: the highest tier among the stories, null when none is scored. `stories` are full stamps plus `liveBranchCount` (the index rows' open forecast questions; null when the story has no row). A link's `reason` is the model's text with the (E..) evidence-code groups removed, `cited` the entries it pointed at; the data carries no line style and no confirmed state (the web notes hold neither). `newFacts`: stories whose stamp `lastEntryAt` is within 7 days before the web index's `generatedAt` (only news entries move it; forecasts, verdicts, merges and placed articles do not). `titleCountries`: the countries (iso3) of two or more of the theme's stories, in `countries` order, at most 4, or the first 4 of `countries` when none is in two stories; `moreCountries`: how many of the other countries are left out. `linkCounts`: the theme's links by strength. `strongestLink`: the best strength, ties by most cited entries, newest cited date, from, to. All three are stamped by the builder; readers never recompute them. Themes: most `newFacts` first, then most strong links, then most stories, then themeId.

titleCountries.description: the countries for the theme title: those of two or more of its stories, in `countries` order, at most 4; when no country is in two stories, the first 4 of `countries`

moreCountries.description: how many of the theme's countries are left out of titleCountries
